name: Mastering AI 2027
description: AI conference for developers: agentic AI, MCP, LLMs, MLOps (formerly Minds Mastering Machines)
details:
Mastering AI is the renamed Minds Mastering Machines (M3), the heise / dpunkt conference on machine learning and AI in practice, held at the IHK Karlsruhe at Friedrichsplatz. The 2027 topics: agentic AI and MCP, GenAI and LLMs, optimizing AI applications, security for and with AI, data protection, experience reports, data engineering and MLOps.

Talks plus full-day workshops; group discount from three people and a discount for students. The call for proposals is open until 19 Nov 2026; ticket prices are not published yet. Nearest tram stop Ettlinger Tor, about five minutes on foot.
note: German; CFP until 19 Nov 2026; group discount from 3
